environment: Isolated Linux checkouts and real ZkTestServer, SolrZkClient, ZooKeeper client and callback dispatch; branch_9x Gradle 8.10, JDK 21, seed 5301C0DE; serialize builds using host lock and record toolchain, ports, process cleanup and host constraints.
head: de36597d1414a6ac24d0d03f80f5b61ceb542ed7
requirements: Before claiming or execution, read assignment, live PR discussion/head and fork ref; check board and host for conflicting work and refresh pinned sources. de36597d is the PR head observed at handoff and adds only the stress fixture changes to 01e820f. dfde9bde is the previously offered fork head. If either moves or PR production code changes, reconcile and issue an appropriate superseding job; do not silently attribute proof to a changed head.

Design the smallest bounded, controlled integration test or diagnostic probe using real ZooKeeper sessions, real SolrZkClient wrapper dispatch and real ConnectionManager. Existing ZkTestServer, SocketProxy and connection test infrastructure are starting points. Use deterministic synchronization at a narrow observation/control seam where possible; document every temporary hook, overlay, induced event, deadline and limitation. Do not mock ZooKeeper state or call ConnectionManager.process with fabricated events as the behavioral proof. Avoid claiming a plausible ordering is a reproduced one.

Establish and record actual session IDs, event delivery/sequence and processing order: expire A to start replacement B; hold B's real SyncConnected callback after event numbering but before state application; observe B's later real Disconnected applied; cause and verify B's real terminal expiration while the A reconnect callback remains blocked; release the held callback and confirm it is rejected as stale and B's expiration is queued behind the blocked reconnect. Demonstrate whether the original manager remains stuck at a bounded recovery assertion while real server connectivity is available. If the proposed schedule cannot occur or a step cannot be made observable, report exactly what happened and why; a setup failure, skip, timing timeout, unrelated listener failure or absent ordering is not a reproduction.

For a meaningful matched comparison, run the identical diagnostic and event controls on the exact PR head de36597d with the original ConnectionManager blob, then on an isolated de36597d checkout with only the production ConnectionManager change from dfde9bde applied as an explicit temporary overlay. Preserve exact test and overlay patches, blob hashes, and evidence that all other production files and event-control mechanisms match. Require the baseline to execute and fail at the intended bounded recovery assertion after the recorded ordering, and the overlay to execute the same scenario and install a healthy replacement C and complete reconnect notification within the deadline. Confirm fix does not merely bypass the schedule. Clearly identify the overlay as uncommitted experimental code, not a tested pushed head; map its blob to the offered fork and state any incompatibility. If matching cannot be achieved, report incomplete or non-reproduced, not a pass.

Capture exact commands, seed, timestamps, environmental conditions, full logs, fresh JUnit XML if applicable, event/session trace, assertions, exit codes, cleanup and SHA-256 for diagnostic and overlay. Record all attempts and investigate failures before reruns. Use focused Gradle target :solr:core:test with the exact selected new or existing integration class/method and -Ptests.seed=5301C0DE --rerun-tasks; enable -Ptests.nightly=true only if the selected class requires it. Record the actual command and fully qualified filter; avoid claiming skipped tests as executed. Retain evidence in an authorized accessible location with a verified pointer and hashes.

Report whether the real-ZooKeeper failure is established, refuted by observed behavior, or remains unproven, and distinguish the historical mocked negative and nightly stress coverage from this experiment. Note any added test seam's realism and maintenance cost, and whether an independently reviewable permanent regression is feasible. No public communication, contributor-branch write, or source push is authorized. A permanent patch or changed pushed head requires a separately scoped follow-up and exact-head gate. Publish structured receipt tied to this gate and head, plus report and executor-stop evidence before release.
